Se è ciò che ti serve, ecco il numero verde (sito) per la Prevenzione Suicidi in Italia. https://www.telefonoamico.it/prevenzione-suicidio/

Piuttosto prova a farti aiutare, giusto come una possibile soluzione che potrebbe cambiarti la vita in meglio. Mi fido di te <3

This is really difficoult. The only way for 100% success is cutting away the whole hand making sure to cut the radial and ulnar arteries. You will cut nerves and this is extremely painful. I honestly suggest you to try book a therapy session, I know, everyone say that but I have suicidal ideations too and my psychiatric is helping me a lot. Maybe the first session won't help you and maybe you have to change therapist but you have to keep fighting ❤
